about: Teranova met HIYO (희요) at the company's stand at InterCHARM Korea 2026.

The company responded positively to Teranova's proposal to introduce its brand and products to buyers in Latin America and North America. The company has not yet confirmed its range, formulations or commercial terms, so they are not shown on this page.
